Furthermore, profit growth exceeds 20% year-on-year alongside quarter-on-quarter profit gains [E24, E25], proving that operational momentum is actively reviving. While borrowings increased to ₹ 0.55 Cr [E14], promoters maintain steady and unwavering skin in the game with a commanding 62.48% stake holding firm [E16].
